about: TheSportsDB: an open, crowd-sourced sports database. This CLI searches teams and players, looks up events, league tables, fixtures, squads and TV schedules through the free public JSON API (key 123) and the server-rendered HTML pages.

commands.summary: Search teams by name via the JSON API (full team record: ids, leagues, stadium, socials, descriptions)
Search players by name via the JSON API (team, nationality, position, birth date)
Get one event/match by its event id (teams, scores, date/time, venue, round, season)
Get the league standings table for a league id and season (rank, points, W/D/L, goals, form)

params.name: league
params.description: League id (idLeague), e.g. 4328 = English Premier League

params.name: season
params.description: Season string, e.g. 2025-2026 (or 2026 for calendar-year leagues)

commands.summary: List the next upcoming events (fixtures) of a league by league id
List a team's most recent results by team id
List all events on a given date, optionally filtered by sport

params.name: sport
params.description: Sport name, e.g. Soccer, Basketball, Ice Hockey, American Football

commands.summary: List the players and staff of a team by team id
List leagues with their ids and sport
Keyword search across teams, players, leagues, venues and events on the website, optionally filtered by sport; returns names and links

params.name: query
params.description: Search keyword (team, player, venue, league or event name)

params.name: sport
params.description: Filter by sport, capitalised as on the site, e.g. Soccer, Motorsport, Basketball

commands.summary: Get a team profile page: name, profile info, next event, manager, stadium, leagues, upcoming fixtures and recent results
Get a player profile page: name, bio facts (born, position, team), description, team and league links
Get a league profile page: name, facts, current season and round, upcoming fixtures and recent results
List all fixtures/results of a league season (optionally for one team or one round)

params.name: team
params.description: Restrict to one team, as id-slug, e.g. 133604-arsenal

params.name: round
params.description: Restrict to one round, two digits, e.g. 07

commands.summary: List TV channels for a country, optionally searching channels by name

params.name: country
params.description: Country slug, lowercase with underscores, e.g. united_kingdom, brazil, canada

commands.summary: List today's televised sports events for a country, with time (UTC) and channels
Get a TV channel's sports schedule for the next 7 days (events with UTC times)
List the featured leagues of a sport from its overview page
